newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - Angping says "hold" RFM.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Angping says "hold" RFM.

text.p: Angping Research recommended a hold on food and beverage firm RFM Corp despite a 17 percent drop in its nine month net income this year.

"This decline is actually an improvement over its first half earnings report where it disclosed a 28 percent decrease in profit caused by high cost of raw materials," Angping said in a study released on Wednesday.
It said RFM's major subsidiares were able to grow despite stiffer competition.
"With the improving performances of its subsidiaries, RFM expects to net anywhere between 500 million pesos to as much as 550 million pesos for the year," Angping said.
